receipts.steps:
How to record goods in:
1. Press '＋ Goods in…'.
2. Choose where the goods come from (border gate / parent company, or a customer return), then type the quantity of each product.
3. Press 'Save goods in' and check. The app records the stock and writes an Excel file of the receipt in output/hang-ve.
A mistake? Press '↶ Undo' right away, or select the receipt and press 'Edit selected…'.
count.hint: Count the goods at each place and type the numbers in the 2 yellow columns (main warehouse, office). A place left empty is not changed. Only products with a count are recorded. The Stock note column is saved at once and shared with the Stock page.
count.confirm: Save the count of {count} products on {date}? Stock will be adjusted to the counts.
transfer.steps:
Only one computer works at a time.
1. Current computer: click 'Export data' → a .dibekho file is created in the output folder.
2. Send that file to the other computer (USB, Zalo, email…).
3. Other computer: copy it into the input folder, go to 'To do' → 'Import data'. Its current data is backed up, then replaced.

backup.title: Backups
backup.hint: The app backs up every day at start and before importing data; the newest 10 are kept, and anything over 30 days old is dropped (tidied up every two weeks).
restore.title: Restore a deleted product
restore.hint: The products below are in a backup but not in the current catalog any more (maybe deleted by mistake). Tick the ones to bring back, then press Restore. A product deleted more than 30 days ago may no longer be in any backup.
restore.none: No deleted product was found in any backup.
restore.pick_first: Tick at least one product first.
restore.duplicate_hint: The product just restored (first row) might be the same as one of the rows below (maybe re-created after the mistaken delete). Tick the one row that really is the same product, then 'Merge into one' to move every document onto the smaller code and free the larger one for the next new product. None of them match? Press 'Keep separate'.
restore.duplicate_pick_first: Tick the one row that is the same product as the one just restored, or press 'Keep separate'.
restore.done: Restored {restored} product(s) ({merged} merged into a product that already existed).

master.title: Master data (Excel)
master.hint: Export the product catalog, the customer list and the stock list to one Excel file to read, check, correct the stock, or load on another computer. Importing it (here, or by putting it into the input folder) gives exactly the same products (same codes), customers and the stock of its Stock sheet. The file holds no orders: to move everything, use 'Export data' above.

reset.title: Reset data
reset.hint: Use this to start over. The app always makes a backup first (restore it in the Data transfer and backups tab). Your files (delivery notes, input, output, backups) are not deleted; notes in phieu-giao-hang/da-xu-ly are moved back to phieu-giao-hang to be read again.
reset.confirm_stock:
Reset stock?

• Kept: the product catalog, learned names on notes, dropped lines.
• Deleted: every delivery note, goods-in, stock count and customer → stock back to 0.
• Notes in phieu-giao-hang/da-xu-ly are moved back to phieu-giao-hang and read again from scratch.

The app makes a backup first.
reset.confirm_all:
Delete all data?

The app goes back to a fresh install: no products, notes, customers or stock. Only the settings are kept (language, size, working folder).

The app makes a backup first.
